definitions.gloss: home delivery service; courier service; parcel delivery
definitions.explanation: A door-to-door parcel delivery service. Originally a brand name of Yamato Transport, but widely used as a generic term for home delivery services in Japan.

examples.japanese: {宅急便|たっきゅうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
{宅急便|たっきゅうびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'd like to change the delivery address for the courier package.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{宅急便|たっきゅうびん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}れなかった→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{再配達|さいはいたつ}→再配達：09690_saihaitatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I wasn't home and couldn't receive the delivery, so I requested redelivery.

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a registered trademark of ⟦{大和|やまと}→大和：12261_yamato⟧{運輸|うんゆ} (Yamato Transport), but used colloquially as a generic term for home delivery services. The generic term is ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧, but {宅急便|たっきゅうびん} is more commonly heard in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宅急便|たっきゅうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send by courier)
- {宅急便|たっきゅうびん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (a delivery arrives)
- {宅急便|たっきゅうびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再配達|さいはいたつ}→再配達：09690_saihaitatsu⟧ (redelivery of a courier package)
- {宅急便|たっきゅうびん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive a delivery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧: home delivery service — the generic, non-branded term
